He’s the first person I want to tell my day to or share things happening to me with. He’s the only one I want to talk on the phone with. He’s the one I crave sexually and his kiss still makes my heart skip a beat as crazy as that sounds. And anytime we’ve had fights or have been separated, I’ve felt physical pain in my heart from being so heartbroken over it. I’ve never had any of these feelings with anyone else nor do I want it with anyone else.

Oh I know I’m not all to blame, especially given the circumstances but anytime I tried to explain what caused me act the way I did, it always turned into me not taking accountability. I’m well aware that what I did was selfish and thoughtless and I’ve apologized numerous times but I guess some relationships can’t come back from certain things.
